title: Read
description: Read pages from a document. Returns MinerU markdown (preferred) or PyPDF text, with optional page screenshots and sub-image fetching. When markdown is available, a figure_images_meta catalog is included — use the figures parameter to fetch specific sub-image pixels.

pages.description: Page numbers to read, e.g. '1,3-5,8'. Recommended: ≤5 pages per call.

with_image.description: Attach full-page screenshots (PNG). Use when layout matters or text extraction failed.

figures.description: Fetch specific sub-images by (page, ref) from the figure_images_meta catalog returned by a previous Read call.

force_figures.description: Bypass minimum-size filter for requested figures.

zoom.description: Zoom factor for page screenshots (with_image only).

doc_id.description: Document identifier. In single-doc mode this defaults to the PDF filename stem. In multi-doc / cross-doc mode, pass one of the doc_ids listed in the user message to select which PDF/markdown to read from.
